$comment: The ONE commit every portability matrix, fixture hash and distribution handshake binds to.
Read only through portability-source-commit.ts; nothing may call `git rev-parse HEAD` at run time.
PROVENANCE OF THIS VALUE: it is not self-referential and cannot be. A pin naming the commit that
carries it is a fixed point no commit can have, so the receipt lands in a FOLLOW-UP commit that
names the evidence-binding commit before it. `sourceCommit` therefore always names an EXISTING
commit, and `externalRun` stays null until an external push run at that exact commit is accepted
by tests/fault/cross-host/exact-sha-evidence-gate.mjs. A null externalRun means UNKNOWN external
evidence -- never a pass. CI overrides `sourceCommit` via MOE_PORTABILITY_SOURCE_COMMIT bound to
the PUSH run's github.sha; the resolver REFUSES when the two disagree rather than picking one.
SEALED 2026-08-20. `node tests/fault/cross-host/exact-sha-evidence-gate.mjs 06c4e9ed...` exited 0,
accepting push run 32376607547 (https://github.com/yaront1111/Moe-NG/actions/runs/32376607547):
host-evidence-linux, host-evidence-darwin and cross-host-aggregate all `success`, and all three
artifacts cross-host-{linux,darwin,aggregate}-06c4e9ed... present, unexpired, non-empty and
sha256-digested.
`aggregateDigest` below is the DERIVED digest carried inside the aggregate body, not the archive
digest GitHub stamps on the upload -- the archive digest is transport metadata, while the derived
one is what the evidence itself commits to. The downloaded cross-host-aggregate artifact holds one
file, aggregate-33251d80...json, whose body reads: aggregateVersion moe-cross-host-aggregate/1,
truthClass PROVEN, source.commitSha 06c4e9ed420eb7302c820274c06945f09eabe1e1 (the same commit this
receipt pins, checked rather than assumed), consumerTaskId task-22cfca91c5134b24aaf3e5734444fb93,
rows [linux PROVEN receiptDigest d3aa5f66..., darwin PROVEN receiptDigest 9c733e89...], and the
distribution handshake distribution.aggregateDigest 2f3b8091... over 6 components (daemon,
control-room, mcp-bridge, provider-claude, provider-codex, ide-adapter-jetbrains). For the record,
the archive digests the gate reported were cross-host-linux sha256:44223a2d..., cross-host-darwin
sha256:8e3d419f..., cross-host-aggregate sha256:78b8a805....
WHY 06c4e9ed AND NOT THE EARLIER e3cd7f2 THIS TASK FIRST PINNED. GitHub raises a push-event run
at the push TIP only, and the 2026-08-20T08:40Z push carried af20a02..747a3e4 in one shot, so no
run has ever existed at e3cd7f2 and an exact-SHA gate pinned there is unsatisfiable forever. The
pin moved FORWARD to the pushed tip, which is an ancestor-superset of e3cd7f2 and still carries
af20a02, the commit that added the portability legs this receipt is evidence for.
KNOWN GAP, RECORDED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER, AND NARROWER THAN THE JOB CONCLUSION SUGGESTS.
In run 32376607547 the job `portability-evidence (macos-latest)` concluded `failure`. The failure
is NOT in the portability matrices: macOS ran the whole vitest integration lane green at
`Test Files 12 passed (12) / Tests 360 passed (360)`, and all four portability matrices are
inside those 12 files. What failed is the node:test leg bundled into the same `pnpm
test:integration` command, tests/integration/release-supply-chain.test.mjs, at
`tests 66 / suites 4 / pass 56 / fail 10` (ERR_FS_EISDIR under /var/folders/**/moe-release-build-*)
-- the release-evidence lane's own macOS red, foreign to this task. Because that leg runs in the
job's FIRST step, the later `Per-matrix executed counts` step never executed, so macOS uploaded no
portability-matrix.json. So the macOS portability rows PASSED but their PER-MATRIX ATTRIBUTION is
UNKNOWN for this commit; Linux carries both (`portability-evidence (ubuntu-latest)` = `success`,
per-matrix 25/32/14/29). Closing the attribution gap means running the matrix-evidence step
independently of the bundled foreign suite, which only becomes provable on a LATER push run.
